name: io.github.BK927/steam-research-mcp
description: Unofficial read-only Steam research through 8 compact game, player, review, community, search, analytics, and job tools.
title: Steam Research MCP Server — Games, Prices, Reviews & Player Analytics

environmentVariables.name: STEAM_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Steam Web API key (optional, free at https://steamcommunity.com/dev/apikey). Keyless game/store/review/AppInfo/community views remain available; a key enables account-specific player views and personalization.

environmentVariables.name: STEAM_USER
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Your own Steam vanity name, SteamID64, or profile URL, so the account tools default to you when you omit a steamid. Public profile name, not a secret.

environmentVariables.name: GAMALYTIC_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional Gamalytic API key. Without it, the analytics view uses Gamalytic's keyless public field subset.
